title: Go, Go, Go! Before The Sun Leaves
trend: TikTok 'Go, Go, Go' (frantic 'go' audio over moments that demand immediate action; New Engen TikTok list updated Nov 4-5 2026, US) + early November darkness after the clocks fell back (sunset before 5 pm across much of the US) — Ray sprints his daughter Kiara through raking, hanging lights and grilling before a chatty Sun clocks out at four fifty one; twist: Ray never changed his watch when the clocks went back, so they had an extra hour all along
youtube_title: Go, go, go! The sun leaves at 4:51 ☀️
description:
It is November and the sun is clocking out early. Ray has a whole Saturday list and thirty six minutes. Kiara has questions about his watch.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #shorts
tiktok_caption: go, go, go! the sun leaves at 4:51 ☀️ #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy

lines.text: Kiara, it is four fifteen. The sun leaves at four fifty one. Go, go, go!
Dad, it is a Saturday. Why are we sprinting?
Because in November the day is a rumor. Rake. Go, go, go!
Good afternoon. Just so everyone knows, I am packing up.
Is the sun talking to us?
Only in November. I like to give people a heads up.
How long do we have?
Thirty six minutes. Then I go see my other customers.
Leaves. Pile. Bag. Go, go, go!
The wind just took the whole pile into the Hendersons' yard.
Then we rake the Hendersons' yard. Go!
They are sitting in it, Dad. They are having a picnic in our leaves.
They brought a thermos. Lovely people.
Wave politely and take the leaves back. Go, go, go!
Twenty nine minutes. I am putting on my coat.
You do not have a coat. You are a ball of fire.
I have a little cloud. It is very slimming.
Lights. On the gutter. Ladder. Go, go, go!
Dad, it is the tenth of November.
And when do you want to hang lights? December? In the dark? In the cold? Like an animal?
The lights are tangled into one big ball.
That is not a tangle. That is a puzzle with a deadline.
Twenty one minutes. I am stretching.
Can you stretch slower?
I have done this every day for a very long time. I am not slowing down for a gutter.
Plug them in. Go!
Half of them work. They spell out a sad face on the roof.
It is a festive sad face. Next. Grill. Go, go, go!
Why are we grilling?
Because a man grills in daylight. After dark I just stand outside with meat.
Fourteen minutes. I am saying goodbye to the birds.
The birds left in October. You are waving at a bag on a branch.
It is a very loyal bag.
Burgers on. Flip. Go, go, go!
Dad, I have been meaning to ask you something.
Ask while you flip.
What time does your watch say?
Four forty four. Seven minutes. Go!
My phone says three forty four.
Your phone is wrong.
My phone changes by itself. Your watch is from the mall in two thousand eleven.
She is right. I was just being polite. I have over an hour.
You said thirty six minutes!
You looked so excited. I did not want to ruin your sprint.
You did not change your watch when the clocks went back.
I changed the microwave. That is the important one.
So for ten days you have been leaving work an hour early?
I thought everybody was just working very late.
They did look surprised every day at three.
So we have an hour.
We have an hour, a sad face on the roof and the Hendersons in our leaves.
Okay. Calm. New plan. We do everything again. Slowly.
I would love to watch that. I will stay a little.
Can you do that?
No. Four fifty one. I have Australia at eight. It is summer there. They need me.
What is it like in Australia?
Everybody grills in daylight. It is your dream, Ray.
Kiara. Pack a bag.
Dad, it is a twenty hour flight.
Then we leave at four fifty one with him. Go, go, go!
Fix your watch first.
Fine. Watch fixed. It is three forty six. Nothing to do.
Now you know how I feel all of July.
